github.title: How to get a GitHub token
github.intro: Use a fine-grained personal access token so this source only sees the repository you choose.
github.step1: Open GitHub Settings, then Developer settings.
github.step2: Choose Personal access tokens, then create a fine-grained token.
github.step3: Select the repository you want Cowork to read.
github.step4: Set an expiration date, generate the token, and paste it into Access token.
github.note: For a mock connection, any token-shaped value works. In a real connector, Cowork would validate the token before saving it.

linear.title: How to get a Linear API key
linear.intro: Create a personal API key from the Linear workspace you want to browse.
linear.step1: Open Linear and switch to the target workspace.
linear.step3: Create a personal API key and copy it once it appears.
linear.step4: Paste the workspace URL and API key into the connect form.
linear.note: Keep the API key private. This mock stores only the connected source id locally, not the field values.
